lines.en: label springtime14:
{i}Far, far away...in a distant land...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}很远、很远的地方……在一片遥远的土地上……{/i}

lines.en: {i}That also happens to be a hotel room...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而那片土地，恰好还是一间酒店客房……{/i}

lines.en: scene xmasdnd1
: Lidearel’s blade ricochets off the worm’s natural armor! And the clang of steel carries across the transparent floor of the void until it’s lost in the dark!
lines.zh: : Lidearel 的刀刃被蠕虫的天然护甲弹开了！钢铁的铿锵声掠过虚空那透明的地面传向远方，最终消失在黑暗里！

lines.en: : Lidearel — as you recoil from your missed attack, the worm burrows back into the smoke beneath your feet, fading from your vision and disappearing into an endless black.
lines.zh: : Lidearel——趁你因落空的一击而后撤，蠕虫钻回你脚下的烟雾之中，从你的视野里淡去，消失在无边的漆黑里。

lines.en: : Suddenly, the ground begins to shake, knocking you prone. The smoke starts to disperse...and you hear a deep, wet rumbling beneath you.
lines.zh: : 突然，地面开始震动，把你震得趴倒在地。烟雾开始消散……你听见身下传来一阵低沉而湿润的隆隆声。

lines.en: : Ew. Why is it wet?
lines.zh: : 咦。为什么是湿的？

lines.en: : It’s a giant worm, Rin. It wouldn’t be as intimidating if it wasn’t wet.
lines.zh: : 那可是条巨型蠕虫，Rin。不湿的话就没那么吓人了。

lines.en: : It’s like sixty feet long, isn’t it? I think it’d be plenty intimidating without the wetness.
lines.zh: : 它得有六十英尺长吧？我觉得就算不湿，也已经够吓人的了。

lines.en: : Silence!...is what comes next.
lines.zh: : 安静！……而接下来，便是一片安静。

lines.en: : A long silence as the rumble fades along with the smoke. The dark becomes darker, but your eyes begin to slowly adjust. Yet, the light from Urrheak’s mace is the only thing keeping you sane.
lines.zh: : 长久的沉默，隆隆声随着烟雾一同消散。黑暗变得更暗，但你们的眼睛开始慢慢适应。然而，唯有 Urrheak 钉头锤上的光，还在维系着你们的理智。

lines.en: : Except for those of you with darkvision. So...Rin and Futaba.
lines.zh: : 当然，有黑暗视觉的除外。也就是……Rin 和 Futaba。

lines.en: : And with that, it is Zagull’s turn.
lines.zh: : 那么，轮到 Zagull 行动了。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd2
: That’s right! Run away! That’ll teach you to mess with Zagull Throat Spear!
lines.zh: : 没错！跑啊！看你们还敢不敢招惹 Zagull Throat Spear！

lines.en: : Zagull slams the...handle thing...of his battle axe into the ground and...lets out a war cry!
lines.zh: : Zagull 把战斧的……那根柄什么的……往地上一砸，然后……发出一声战吼！

lines.en: : Zagull’s blood begins to boil as he goes into a rage! But upon striking the ground, you deal one damage to Lidearel as she’s prone right next to you and you are very strong.
lines.zh: : Zagull 的血液开始沸腾，他陷入了狂暴！但由于击打地面时，倒在你身旁的 Lidearel 被波及，而你力气极大，因此你对 Lidearel 造成了 1 点伤害。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd3
: Not the best spot to take a nap...is it, human?
lines.zh: : 可不是打盹的好地方……对吧，人类？

lines.en: : Well excuse me, {i}orc.{/i} But some of us would prefer to fight with {i}speed{/i} rather than power. Which might be why {i}some of us{/i} still have all our limbs.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉啊，{i}兽人{/i}。不过我们有些人更愿意靠{i}速度{/i}而非力量作战。这大概也是为什么{i}有些人{/i}四肢还健全。

lines.en: : Zagull, do you do anything else? Or is that your turn?
lines.zh: : Zagull，你还做别的吗？还是说你的回合就到此为止？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd4
: We still can’t...see the worm?
lines.zh: : 我们还是……看不见那条蠕虫？

lines.en: : Correct. It’s burrowed.
lines.zh: : 没错。它钻进地里了。

lines.en: : Then...that’s my turn...
lines.zh: : 那……我的回合结束……

lines.en: : Zagull and Lidearel stop arguing long enough for Urrheak to regain his footing as he prepares to...
lines.zh: : Zagull 和 Lidearel 总算停止争吵，趁着这段时间，Urrheak 重新站稳脚跟，准备……

lines.en: : Fly.
lines.zh: : 起飞。

lines.en: : Okay! So Urrheak’s footing is not prepared for long as he quickly ascends above the rest of his party.
lines.zh: : 好的！那 Urrheak 的脚跟可没站稳多久，他迅速升到了队伍其余人的上空。

lines.en: : After that, I retreat to Nithhala’s position and cast {i}lesser restoration{/i} on her.
lines.zh: : 之后，我退到 Nithhala 的位置，对她施放{i}次级复原术{/i}。

lines.en: : Urrheak blankets the Tiefling warlock with his wings, and she can feel the poison coursing through her veins slowly begin to dissipate. The poison is gone. But the puncture wound still stings.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 用双翼裹住这名提夫林术士，她能感到血管里奔流的毒液开始慢慢消散。毒解了。但那道穿刺伤仍在作痛。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd5
: Thanks, bird bro. I knew I could count on you.
lines.zh: : 谢了，鸟哥。我就知道能指望你。

lines.en: : Scraw.
lines.zh: : Scraw.

lines.en: : Nithhala does not understand your response as she does not speak bird. Is that your turn?
lines.zh: : Nithhala 听不懂你的回答，因为她不会说鸟语。你的回合结束了吗？

lines.en: : Before I end my turn, I move back toward my original position in the air and turn to address the group.
lines.zh: : 结束回合前，我先飞回空中原本的位置，转身面向大家。

lines.en: : In birdspeak or common?
lines.zh: : 用鸟语还是通用语？

lines.en: : Common — Lidearel. Zagull. This is not the time to argue. We need to spread out before the beast returns. Form a circle and-
lines.zh: : 通用语——Lidearel。Zagull。现在不是吵架的时候。我们得在野兽回来之前散开。围成一个圈，然后——

lines.en: scene xmasdnd6
: Before Urrheak can finish his sentence, the rumbling returns! Faster than and louder and {i}wetter{/i} than ever before!
lines.zh: : Urrheak 话还没说完，隆隆声又回来了！比以往更快、更响，还更{i}湿{/i}！

lines.en: : Ew! Come on!
lines.zh: : 恶心！别这样！

lines.en: : And with it, comes the worm! It passes directly through the floor of the abyss that remains solid and firm for the lot of you!
lines.zh: : 伴随着它，蠕虫来了！它径直穿过深渊的地面冲了上来——而那地面在你们众人脚下依旧坚实牢固！

lines.en: scene xmasdnd7
: Urrheak, dwarfed by the colossal beast, is unable to react in time.
lines.zh: : 被这头巨兽衬得无比渺小的 Urrheak，来不及做出反应。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd8
: And as it descends back to the ground to re-engage, it attempts to bite him.
lines.zh: : 而当它俯冲回地面重新接战时，它试图咬住他。

lines.en: : From the sky? Are you kidding? I’m supposed to be safe up here. I’m a bird.
lines.zh: : 从天上？你开玩笑吧？我在上面应该很安全才对。我可是只鸟。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} a sixty foot worm. You wouldn’t have been able to get high enough in just one turn to avoid it unless you used both your action {i}and{/i} bonus action on-
lines.zh: : 那是一条六十英尺长的蠕虫。你不可能在一个回合内就飞得足够高躲开它，除非你把行动{i}和{/i}附赠动作都用上——

lines.en: : I retract my lesser restoration. Nithhala can stay poisoned.
lines.zh: : 我收回我的次级复原术。Nithhala 可以继续中毒。

lines.en: : Nooo! I only have like 10 HP left!
lines.zh: : 不要啊！我只剩大概 10 点血了！

lines.en: : Then use a potion, Rin.
lines.zh: : 那就喝瓶药水，Rin。

lines.en: : No! I’m saving them for when I need them!
lines.zh: : 不！我要留到真需要的时候再用！

lines.en: : Is this not-
lines.zh: : 这难道不是——

lines.en: : Silence!
lines.zh: : 安静！

lines.en: scene xmasdnd9
: The worm manages to bite Urrheak's leg as it descends.
lines.zh: : 蠕虫下坠时，成功咬住了 Urrheak 的腿。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd8
: Dealing a total of...
lines.zh: : 总共造成……

lines.en: scene xmasdnd9
: Dealing a total of 19 damage. Then another 5 damage to the rest of the party when it slams back into the ground, which Urrheak manages to avoid on account of being a bird.
lines.zh: : 总共造成 19 点伤害。它砸回地面时又对队伍其余成员造成 5 点伤害，Urrheak 因为是一只鸟而躲过了这一下。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd10
: Jesus. Now I really want Nithhala to be poisoned again.
lines.zh: : 天啊。我现在真的希望 Nithhala 重新中毒算了。

lines.en: : Urrheak, go ahead and make a dex saving roll.
lines.zh: : Urrheak，去做一次敏捷豁免检定。

lines.en: : And if I refuse?
lines.zh: : 我要是拒绝呢？

lines.en: : You will be swallowed by the worm.
lines.zh: : 你会被蠕虫吞下去。

lines.en: : The worm already landed. It’s on the ground now. Is it going to jump back into the sky to try and eat me? Because that seems a little excessive.
lines.zh: : 蠕虫已经落地了。它现在就在地面上。它还要跳回天上来吃我吗？这也太夸张了吧。

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} This is the second part of its bite attack. It bites you, then you have to make a dexterity saving throw to see whether or not you’re swallowed.
lines.zh: : {i}不。{/i}这是它撕咬攻击的第二阶段。它咬住你，然后你必须做一次敏捷豁免检定，判定自己是否被吞下。

lines.en: : I think I should get a pass on this since it already landed and damaged everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这次该给我个豁免，毕竟它已经落地，还伤了其他所有人。

lines.en: : You feckin’...fine! I’ll make sure to be {i}extra{/i} careful about the order in which I narrate things in the future.
lines.zh: : 你这该死的……行！我以后一定会{i}格外{/i}注意叙述事情的顺序。

lines.en: : Thank you. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我很感激。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think this...worm is intentionally avoiding me...It keeps burrowing before I get the chance to attack it...
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得这条……蠕虫在故意躲着我……它每次都在我出手之前钻进地里……

lines.en: scene xmasdnd11
: It probably senses that you’re its biggest threat.
lines.zh: : 大概是它感觉到你是最大的威胁。

lines.en: : Molly, I should have knowledge of this creature based on my background, right? Because I know what it is, but I don’t want to share any details about it if it’s going to be meta-gaming.
lines.zh: : Molly，基于我的背景设定，我应该对这种生物有所了解吧？因为我知道它是什么，但如果这算超游的话，我就不透露任何细节了。

lines.en: : That is correct. Xessaxia would have a somewhat advanced knowledge of what this creature is based on her past as a hunter.
lines.zh: : 没错。Xessaxia 曾经是个猎人，凭她的过去，对这种生物会有相当深入的了解。

lines.en: : Is the worm’s turn over? Can I go now?
lines.zh: : 蠕虫的回合结束了吗？现在能轮到我了吗？

lines.en: : Yes, you may take your turn.
lines.zh: : 是的，你可以行动了。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd12
: Zagull! Try and stay still! This creature can sense movement! It feels how heavy you are and is trying to stay away from you!
lines.zh: : Zagull！尽量别动！这生物能感知移动！它能察觉你有多重，正在躲着你！

lines.en: : I’m sure it doesn’t help that he keeps yelling either.
lines.zh: : 他一直大吼大叫，估计也没帮上什么忙。

lines.en: : There is also that, yes.
lines.zh: : 这一点也是，没错。

lines.en: : Stay still?! You expect the great Zagull Throat Spear to stay {i}still?!{/i} I will have this worm’s heart!
lines.zh: : 别动？！你指望伟大的 Zagull Throat Spear{i}一动不动{/i}？！我要挖出这蠕虫的心脏！

lines.en: : W...Worms have hearts, right?
lines.zh: : 蠕……蠕虫有心脏吗？

lines.en: : Uh...p...probably?
lines.zh: : 呃……应……应该有吧？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd13
: After warning Zagull about the worm, I retreat 30 feet and aim my bow at it.
lines.zh: : 提醒过 Zagull 之后，我后退 30 英尺，把弓对准蠕虫。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd14
: Xessaxia draws the bowstring back and launches a ranged attack.
lines.zh: : Xessaxia 拉开弓弦，发动一次远程攻击。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd15
: That is a...24.
: Hit. Roll for damage.
lines.zh: : 命中。掷伤害。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd14
: I’m going to use {i}colossus slayer{/i} here as well.
lines.zh: : 我还要在这里用上{i}弑巨者{/i}。

lines.en: : Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 请便。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd15
: That is...13 points of damage.
lines.zh: : 那是……13 点伤害。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd16
: Then, once the arrow connects, Xessaxia redraws the string and fires again.
lines.zh: : 接着，箭一命中，Xessaxia 重新拉弦，再次射击。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd17
: This time it’s...a 21.
: Also a hit. Roll for damage.
lines.zh: : 也命中。掷伤害。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd16
: Then, without colossus slayer, that’s another...
lines.zh: : 那么，不用弑巨者的话，还有……

lines.en: scene xmasdnd17
: That’s another 9 points of damage.
lines.zh: : 还有 9 点伤害。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd18
: Despite taking two direct hits from Xessaxia’s longbow, the great worm pays little attention to the damage it receives, completely ignoring the arrows stuck in its side!
lines.zh: : 尽管挨了 Xessaxia 长弓的两次直击，巨蠕虫对所受的伤害毫不在意，完全无视了插在它侧腹的箭矢！

lines.en: : You can tell the creature is nowhere near finished just yet as it lets out a shrill scream that carries across the abyss and sinks deep into the backs of your minds.
lines.zh: : 你们看得出来，这生物远未到穷途末路——它发出一声尖厉的嘶鸣，响彻深渊，深深钻进你们的后脑。

lines.en: : But when it arrives there, it changes into something you can {i}understand.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但当那声音抵达那里时，它变成了你们能{i}理解{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : While the shape it takes is not one of words or language, it’s one of nostalgia. It brings back memories from your past that you’d all but forgotten. But then...they fade.
lines.zh: : 虽然它呈现的形态并非言语或语言，却是一种怀旧。它唤回了你们早已遗忘的过往记忆。可随后……它们又消散了。

lines.en: : And you’re right back in the abyss, face to face with a creature that seems far too powerful to defeat.
lines.zh: : 而你们又回到了深渊之中，正面遇上了一头看起来强大得根本无法战胜的生物。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd19
: Nothing is too powerful for Nithhala, the tiefling warlock with 5 HP!
lines.zh: : 对 Nithhala 来说，没有什么太强大的——那个只剩 5 点血的提夫林术士！

lines.en: : That’s very nice, Nithhala. But it’s Ram’s turn right now.
lines.zh: : 很好，Nithhala。不过现在轮到 Ram 行动。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd20
: Damn it. But what if Tsuneyo gets the last hit and I can’t feed its soul to my staff?
lines.zh: : 该死。可要是最后一击被 Tsuneyo 抢走，我就没法把它的灵魂喂给我的法杖了！

lines.en: : Were you not listening? The creature is nowhere near...actually, forget it. Ram, what do you want to do?
lines.zh: : 你没在听吗？那生物离……算了，当我没说。Ram，你想做什么？

lines.en: : Remember, you still have all your spell slots available. And casting something with utility in a tense group battle like this should-
lines.zh: : 别忘了，你的法术位还是全满的。在这种紧张的团体战里，施放一个带功能性的法术，应该——

lines.en: : I would like to use {i}vicious mockery.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想使用{i}恶毒嘲笑{/i}。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd21
: Good call. If we can’t defeat it, we might as well make it feel really insignificant right before it kills all of us.
lines.zh: : 好主意。既然打不过，不如在它杀光我们之前，先让它觉得自己真的很微不足道。

lines.en: : Are you...sure that’s what you want to do, Ram?
lines.zh: : 你……确定要这么做吗，Ram？

lines.en: : I have never been more sure of anything in my life. I have figured out this boss battle and am prepared to put an end to the great worm.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没这么确定过。我已经摸清了这场首领战，准备好终结这头巨蠕虫了。

lines.en: : Well, alright. Go ahead and insult the worm.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就去羞辱蠕虫吧。

lines.en: : {i}Great{/i} worm? More like not-so-great worm. Bam. Zoom. Mockery complete.
lines.zh: : {i}巨{/i}蠕虫？不如叫不怎么巨的蠕虫。砰。唰。嘲讽完毕。

lines.en: : The worm does not react.
lines.zh: : 蠕虫毫无反应。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd22
: Damn it. It must be deaf.
lines.zh: : 该死。它一定是聋的。

lines.en: : Hey, for your bonus action, can you give me {i}bardic inspiration?{/i} I’ve got an idea for my next turn and, with {i}my{/i} rolls, I need all the help I can get.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你的附赠动作能不能给我一个{i}诗人激励{/i}？我下一回合有个想法，而凭「我」的骰运，能多拿点帮助就多拿点。

lines.en: : I am a failure. I can not inspire anyone. I end my turn.
lines.zh: : 我是个废物。我激励不了任何人。我的回合结束。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd23
: Ugh...god damn it.
lines.zh: : 呃……该死。

lines.en: : Nithhala, how do you proceed?
lines.zh: : Nithhala，你要怎么做？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd24
: Question first — what is the current state of the worm’s mouth?
lines.zh: : 先问一句——蠕虫的嘴现在是什么状态？

lines.en: : Don’t say wet.
lines.zh: : 别说湿的。

lines.en: : I was going to say “what” because I have no idea what that means.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说「什么」，因为我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Like, is its mouth open or closed?
lines.zh: : 就是，它的嘴是张着还是闭着？

lines.en: : Why wouldn't you just-
lines.zh: : 你为什么不直接——

lines.en: : Its mouth is open.
lines.zh: : 它的嘴是张着的。

lines.en: : Then, I want to use that scroll I found in a chest during our last adventure.
lines.zh: : 那么，我想用上次冒险时在宝箱里找到的那卷卷轴。

lines.en: : You mean the “Scroll of TBD?”
lines.zh: : 你是说那卷「待定卷轴」？

lines.en: : Is that its actual name? I thought that was just a placeholder.
lines.zh: : 那是它真正的名字吗？我还以为那只是个占位符。

lines.en: : Um...Rin? Shouldn’t you let someone who...can actually hit with spells...use that scroll?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Rin？你不该让一个……真的能用法术打中的人……来用那卷轴吗？

lines.en: : I’m on Futaba’s side. That thing’s too mysterious to waste on a 5. I want to know what it does.
lines.zh: : 我站 Futaba 这边。那东西太神秘了，不值得浪费在一个 5 上。我想知道它到底有什么用。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd25
: No! It’s my scroll and I want to actually do something for once!
lines.zh: : 不！这是我的卷轴，我就想真正做点事情，哪怕只有一次！

lines.en: : I refuse to go down without a fight and, as it stands, I’m going to die the next time this thing looks at me!
lines.zh: : 我绝不甘心就这么倒下，而照现在的状况，这东西再看我一眼我就要死了！

lines.en: scene xmasdnd26
: Molly, I activate the scroll and attempt to throw it into the worm's mouth.
lines.zh: : Molly，我激活卷轴，试图把它扔进蠕虫的嘴里。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. Go ahead and roll to hit, I guess?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。那就掷命中吧，大概？

lines.en: : I will! And I will now roll something that is hopefully higher than a 5!
lines.zh: : 我会的！我现在就掷一个希望能高过 5 的数！

lines.en: scene xmasdnd27
: We are all doomed. It has been a fun campaign.
lines.zh: : 我们全完了。这场战役很愉快。

lines.en: : D...Don’t give up now, Tsuneyo...Rin might...I mean...N...Nithhala might...
lines.zh: : 别……别现在放弃啊，Tsuneyo……Rin 也许……我是说……N……Nithhala 也许……

lines.en: : Silence...I need to {i}focus.{/i}
lines.zh: : 安静……我需要{i}专注{/i}。

lines.en: : On...what?
lines.zh: : 专注……什么？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd28
scene xmasdnd29
scene xmasdnd30
: Holy fuck, I rolled a 20!
lines.zh: : 我操，我掷出了 20！

lines.en: : What? No way. You-
lines.zh: : 什么？不可能。你——

lines.en: : Odin’s beard...that’s a natural 20.
lines.zh: : Odin 的胡子啊……那是天然 20。

lines.en: : Maya...the dice you got me for Christmas broke my curse...I can roll higher than a 5 now!
lines.zh: : Maya……你圣诞节送我的骰子破除我的诅咒了……我现在能掷出比 5 更高的数了！

lines.en: : Hooray. Now, here’s hoping you roll a 10,000 for damage so we can kill this thing and get our reward.
lines.zh: : 好耶。那么，希望你能掷出 10000 点伤害，好让我们干掉这东西拿到奖励。

lines.en: : Rin, I can’t believe I’m saying this, but roll for damage.
lines.zh: : Rin，我真不敢相信自己会这么说，但掷伤害吧。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd31
: Hell yeah! I’ve waited my whole life to hear those words!
lines.zh: : 太爽了！我这辈子就等着听这句话！

lines.en: scene xmasdnd32
scene xmasdnd32
: That’s...30 points of damage.
lines.zh: : 那是……30 点伤害。

lines.en: : It's 60, actually. You see, this is an ancient scroll created by the Order of the Flame that combines all of the great fire magics into-
lines.zh: : 其实是 60。你要知道，这是一卷由烈焰教团创造的古老卷轴，它把所有伟大的火焰法术融合成了——

lines.en: : Awesome, yeah. Just tell me how much damage I do because I've never been able to actually {i}do{/i} any damage before and this is new and exciting to me.
lines.zh: : 酷，嗯。直接告诉我造成多少伤害就行，因为我从来没能真正{i}造成{/i}过任何伤害，这对我来说又新鲜又激动。

lines.en: : Uhh...Well, I suppose that depends on the worm’s dex saving roll. Let’s see.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，我想这取决于蠕虫的敏捷豁免。让我看看。

lines.en: : It has to make a saving throw too?
lines.zh: : 它也得做豁免检定？

lines.en: : Like I was saying, it's a very complicated spell that-
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，这是个非常复杂的法术——

lines.en: : Doesn't matter! Numbers, please!
lines.zh: : 无所谓了！报数字，谢谢！

lines.en: : Hah...
scene xmasdnd33
: That’s...yup.
lines.zh: : 那是……没错。

lines.en: : The worm takes 60 points of damage, but an additional effect triggers due to the missed save and now Maya has to make a dex saving throw as well.
lines.zh: : 蠕虫受到 60 点伤害，但由于豁免失败触发了额外效果，现在 Maya 也得做一次敏捷豁免检定。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd34
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd35
: Yeah, what? Why? Did this ancient order of fire mages have a thing against birds? Is there anti-avian technology embedded into the scroll?
lines.zh: : 对啊，什么？为什么？难道这群远古火法跟鸟有什么过节？卷轴里还嵌了反鸟类技术？

lines.en: : No. It's because every creature in a 20-foot radius surrounding the scroll's point of impact is subject to an additional aftershock effect.
lines.zh: : 不是。因为卷轴落点周围 20 英尺半径内的所有生物，都会受到一次额外的余波影响。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd36
: I cure you and you {i}kill{/i} me? This is the thanks I get?
lines.zh: : 我治好了你，你却来{i}杀{/i}我？这就是我得到的报答？

lines.en: : B-But! The...the scroll went into its mouth! Maya should be safe! The aftershock should like...hurt the worm's organs or something!
lines.zh: : 可、可是！那……那卷轴进了它的嘴里！Maya 应该安全才对！余波应该……是伤到蠕虫的内脏什么的吧！

lines.en: : That’s right, Nithhala. You {i}beg{/i} to make this right.
lines.zh: : 正是，Nithhala。你{i}求{/i}我把这事掰回来。

lines.en: : It {i}will{/i} damage the worm's organs. It will just {i}also{/i} damage Maya because the aftershock isn't impacted by corners and other LOS-breaking obstacles or obstructions.
lines.zh: : 它{i}会{/i}损伤蠕虫的内脏。只是它{i}也{/i}会伤到 Maya，因为余波不受拐角和其他阻断视线的障碍物影响。

lines.en: : Mouths aren’t corners! They’re mouths!
lines.zh: : 嘴又不是拐角！那是嘴！

lines.en: : {i}Unbelievable.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}难以置信。{/i}

lines.en: : Rin, it’s okay. Maya isn’t dead yet. And if she’s downed, she can heal herself as soon as we pick her back up.
lines.zh: : Rin，没事的。Maya 还没死。就算她倒下了，我们一把她拉起来，她就能自己治疗。

lines.en: : Maya. Your roll. And don’t even try to talk your way out of this one.
lines.zh: : Maya。掷你的骰。而且这次别想靠嘴皮子蒙混过去。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd37
: Tch.
scene xmasdnd38
scene xmasdnd39
: The abyss glows orange as Nithhala activates the scroll!
lines.zh: : Nithhala 激活卷轴，深渊泛起橙光！

lines.en: : The deafening sound of a roaring flame fills the room before a giant sphere of fire forms in the mouth of the worm, exploding seconds later and igniting both the worm {i}and{/i} the Aarakocra.
lines.zh: : 震耳欲聋的烈焰咆哮声充斥整个房间，随后一个巨大的火球在蠕虫口中成形，几秒后炸开，同时点燃了蠕虫{i}和{/i}那只 Aarakocra。

lines.en: : The worm takes 60 points of damage and winces, yet still appears to be mostly unshaken once the initial pain is gone!
lines.zh: : 蠕虫受到 60 点伤害，微微抽搐，然而最初的痛楚过去后，它看上去依旧基本不为所动！

lines.en: : Thankfully for Urrheak, the force of the blast combined with his presence in the air sends him flying back 20 feet! But he still takes 30 points of damage from the fire and collapses to the floor.
lines.zh: : 对 Urrheak 而言幸运的是，爆炸的冲击加上他身处空中，把他震飞出 20 英尺！但他仍受到 30 点火焰伤害，瘫倒在地。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Maya!
lines.zh: : 对不起，Maya！

lines.en: : It’s fine. Just help me back up and I’ll heal myself like Futaba said.
lines.zh: : 没事。扶我起来就行，我会像 Futaba 说的那样自己治疗。

lines.en: : Who’s next?...It’s...Lidearel again, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 下一个是谁？……是……又是 Lidearel，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes...
scene xmasdnd40
scene xmasdnd41
: The worm pauses. You can sense that something is...{i}changing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 蠕虫顿住了。你们能感觉到，有什么正在{i}改变{/i}。

lines.en: : The smoke that occupied the space beneath the abyssal floor grows...you can see it expanding! Filling up and pressing against what you can only rationalize as an invisible barrier!
lines.zh: : 占据深渊地面下方空间的烟雾在……你们能看见它在膨胀！不断充盈，挤压着你们只能理解为某种无形屏障的东西！

lines.en: : Lighting forms within the smoke, like storm clouds surging! Prepared to rain chaos on whatever lies beneath the surface!
lines.zh: : 烟中生成了闪电，如同翻涌的雷云！准备将混乱倾泻在地表之下的一切之上！

lines.en: : But then it stops...
lines.zh: : 但接着它停下了……

lines.en: : Everything stops...
lines.zh: : 一切都停下了……

lines.en: : Yet the darkness does not fade.
lines.zh: : 然而黑暗并未消退。

lines.en: : The worm slumps down. It looks...{i}tired.{/i}
lines.zh: : 蠕虫瘫软下来。它看起来……{i}累了{/i}。

lines.en: : In that moment, though...you hear something.
lines.zh: : 然而就在那一刻……你们听见了什么。

lines.en: : It’s not the sound of a coming storm or another scream that forces you back to a point in life you’d rather forget...it’s another rumbling.
lines.zh: : 那不是即将到来的风暴之声，也不是又一声把你们拽回人生中不愿记起的某个瞬间的嘶鸣……那是另一阵隆隆声。

lines.en: : But this time, it comes from {i}inside{/i} the worm.
lines.zh: : 但这一次，它来自蠕虫的{i}体内{/i}。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd42
: It opens its mouth wider...You can smell the scorched flesh of its throat as chunks of it begin to peel and fall off, dissolving once they hit the ground.
lines.zh: : 它把嘴张得更大……你们能闻到它喉咙里烧焦的肉味，一块块焦肉开始剥落，一碰到地面便溶解殆尽。

lines.en: : Then...a silhouette.
lines.zh: : 然后……一个轮廓。

lines.en: : From the back of the worm’s throat, you see a humanoid figure walking toward you...fearless. As if he’s walking down a hallway.
lines.zh: : 从蠕虫的喉咙深处，你们看见一个人形身影朝你们走来……毫无惧色。就像他只是走在一道走廊上。

lines.en: : But as the figure draws closer, that humanoid silhouette takes on an air of what could only be described as {i}godliness.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但随着那身影走近，那道人形轮廓染上了一种只能用{i}神性{/i}来形容的气质。

lines.en: : He towers over all of you, even from a distance — making the great worm’s teeth look like arm-guards as he uses them to regain his balance.
lines.zh: : 他居高临下地俯视你们所有人，即便隔着一段距离——他把巨蠕虫的牙齿当作扶手来稳住身形，衬得那些牙像是护臂。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd43
: He uses its tongue like a set of stairs...descending without a care in the world until he stands right before Urrheak.
lines.zh: : 他把它的舌头当成一级级台阶……漫不经心地走下来，直到他站定在 Urrheak 面前。

lines.en: : You notice his head, cloaked in white rags, revealing {i}nothing{/i} of his face. And the color of his skin, so white that it becomes a {i}new{/i} light in the darkness as Urrheak’s mace fizzles out.
lines.zh: : 你们注意到他的头被白布裹着，{i}丝毫{/i}看不出面容。而他皮肤的白，白到成了黑暗中的一束{i}新{/i}光，Urrheak 的钉头锤就此熄灭。

lines.en: : The worm slinks away...burrowing back into the ground and disappearing into the smoke as the giant man stands tall.
lines.zh: : 蠕虫悄悄退开……钻回地下，消失在烟雾里，而那巨人巍然矗立。

lines.en: : He does not act. He does not attack. He simply stands there...waiting.
lines.zh: : 他不动。他不攻击。他只是站在那里……等待。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd44
: But...he’s standing in front of me? Specifically?
lines.zh: : 可是……他是站在我面前？特意站在我面前？

lines.en: : Yes. But you’re unable to tell if it’s intentional or not as he does not speak. He does not even acknowledge your existence.
lines.zh: : 是的。但你们无法判断这是否有意为之，因为他不说话。他甚至不承认你们的存在。

lines.en: : Do any of us know what sort of being this creature is?
lines.zh: : 我们当中有人知道这生物是什么来头吗？

lines.en: : Ram, roll for history.
lines.zh: : Ram，掷一次历史检定。

lines.en: : You got it, dude.
lines.zh: : 交给我吧，老兄。

lines.en: : Ram? Why Ram?
lines.zh: : Ram？为什么是 Ram？

lines.en: : I rolled a 5. Nithhala must have passed her curse onto me.
lines.zh: : 我掷了个 5。Nithhala 一定把她的诅咒传给我了。

lines.en: : No one knows what sort of being this creature is — but you can tell that, like the great worm, its power is on a level far from yours.
lines.zh: : 没人知道这生物是什么来头——但你们能看出，和那头巨蠕虫一样，它的力量远在你们的水准之上。

lines.en: : Yet...it seems almost frail in a way. Like it’s not asking for help, but...{i}expecting{/i} it. And you can only imagine how powerful it would feel if it {i}received{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 然而……它看起来又有些脆弱。像是它并非在求助，而是在{i}期待{/i}帮助。而你们只能想象，一旦它真{i}得到{/i}了帮助，那股力量会何等强大。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd45
: Should we, like...{i}ask?{/i} It’s obviously not hostile if it hasn’t attacked us yet.
lines.zh: : 我们要不要，就是……{i}问问它{/i}？既然它还没攻击我们，显然不具敌意。

lines.en: : I...don’t know. As Xessaxia, I mean. Because, as Futaba, I have an idea of...what it could be, but...I can’t really figure out why it would be inside of a worm.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。我是说作为 Xessaxia。因为作为 Futaba，我对它「可能」是什么有点想法，但……我实在想不通它为什么会在一条蠕虫体内。

lines.en: : I think-
lines.zh: : 我觉得——

lines.en: : I don’t care about what you think. You nearly killed me.
lines.zh: : 我不管你怎么想。你差点害死我。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这倒也是。

lines.en: : Sana? Ayane? Any ideas?
lines.zh: : Sana？Ayane？有什么想法吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t really know either.
lines.zh: : 我……我也不知道。

lines.en: : Ayane then?
lines.zh: : 那 Ayane 呢？

lines.en: : Hello? Ayane? Are you still alive?
lines.zh: : 喂？Ayane？你还活着吗？

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah...sorry. I...
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯……抱歉。我……

lines.en: : I don’t know either...
lines.zh: : 我也不知道……

lines.en: scene xmasdnd46
: Then, I guess I’ll just speak to it since I can’t imagine we’ll be able to find a way out of here without its help.
lines.zh: : 那么，我想还是由我来跟它说话吧，毕竟我想象不出，没有它的帮助我们怎么找到出去的路。

lines.en: : You know, it’s all Ami’s fault for getting us into this mess in the first place. And then she has the audacity to not even show up for the boss fight.
lines.zh: : 说起来，把我们卷进这摊烂事本来全是 Ami 的错。结果她居然好意思连首领战都不来。

lines.en: : Shush. Urrheak, what do you say to the figure?
lines.zh: : 嘘。Urrheak，你要对那个身影说什么？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd47
: If-
lines.zh: : 如果——

lines.en: : Upon hearing Urrheak’s voice, the figures head immediately snaps downward, like a statue coming to life or a security camera identifying its target. It locks onto his eyes despite its face still being concealed.
lines.zh: : 一听到 Urrheak 的声音，那身影的头立刻向下猛地一转，就像雕像活了过来，或是监控摄像头锁定了目标。尽管脸仍被遮住，它已牢牢锁住了他的双眼。

lines.en: : If you wouldn’t mind, could you give me a hand? I’ve found myself slightly injured after playing with your {i}pet{/i} just now.
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意的话，能搭把手吗？刚才跟你的{i}宠物{/i}玩闹一番后，我受了点轻伤。

lines.en: : The figure does not respond.
lines.zh: : 那身影没有回应。

lines.en: : Maybe we should just...you know...leave the weird figure alone and go look for a way out? He might not be hostile, but it doesn’t seem like he wants to help.
lines.zh: : 也许我们该……就是……别管那道奇怪的身影，自己去找出口？它可能没有敌意，但看起来也不像想帮忙。

lines.en: : Maybe he just can’t hear us? He’s got that thing covering his head after all.
lines.zh: : 也许它只是听不见我们？毕竟它头上罩着那东西。

lines.en: : He might...need us to free him? Like...he can’t remove the covering for some reason?...
lines.zh: : 它也许……需要我们帮它解脱？比如……它自己没法摘下那层遮盖？……

lines.en: scene xmasdnd48
: Should one of us walk up to it? Urrheak’s still down, so he can’t. Right?
lines.zh: : 要不要谁走过去？Urrheak 还倒着，所以他不行。对吧？

lines.en: : Enough time has passed for Urrheak to be able to pick himself back up if he wants to.
lines.zh: : 时间已经过去，Urrheak 要是想起来的话，是能自己站起来的。

lines.en: : I guess I can try. But maybe we should all heal ourselves first in case another fight starts?
lines.zh: : 我想我可以试试。不过也许我们该先把大家都治好，以防又开战？

lines.en: : Can we take a short rest here?
lines.zh: : 我们能在这里短休吗？

lines.en: : You may not rest here, no.
lines.zh: : 不行，你们不能在这里休息。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta be careful with healing too. It could interpret that as a hostile action.
lines.zh: : 治疗也得小心。它可能会把那当成敌对行为。

lines.en: : You’re just...saying that because you...don’t want to share any of your potions...
lines.zh: : 你只是……这么说，是因为你……不想分出任何药水……

lines.en: : Maya can have one. She’s earned it.
lines.zh: : Maya 可以来一瓶。这是她应得的。

lines.en: : In that case, I take {i}two{/i} healing potions from Nithhala and use them on myself before making my way back over to the weird giant figure.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我从 Nithhala 手里拿走{i}两瓶{/i}治疗药水用在自己身上，然后走回那个奇怪的巨人身影那边。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd49
: Hey! I said one!
lines.zh: : 喂！我说的是一瓶！

lines.en: : Sucks to suck.
lines.zh: : 活该。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd50
: That’s...14 points of healing. Probably not ideal, but I don’t want to be out of spell slots if we wind up getting into another fight, so I’ll take it.
lines.zh: : 那是……14 点治疗。大概不太理想，但万一又打起来，我不想把法术位耗光，所以就先这样吧。

lines.en: : Urrheak gulps down the potions and can feel his vitality beginning to return.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 一口气灌下药水，能感到自己的活力开始回归。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd51
: I guess I have to fly up to this thing’s head then, right? Isn’t it like, crazy tall?
lines.zh: : 那我大概得飞到这东西的头部去了，对吧？它是不是高得离谱？

lines.en: scene xmasdnd52
: Is that what you do?
lines.zh: : 你就是这么做的？

lines.en: : I guess so, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我想是的，嗯。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd53

: You arrive at the figure’s head and find that it’s about twice the size of your body. Thanks to the silence in the void, you’re able to hear a strange {i}whirring{/i} sound emitting from behind the covering.
lines.zh: : 你抵达那身影的头部，发现它大约有你身形的两倍大。多亏虚空中的寂静，你能听见遮盖物后传出一阵奇怪的{i}嗡鸣{/i}。

lines.en: : A...whirring sound?
lines.zh: : 嗡……嗡鸣声？

lines.en: : Yes, a whirring sound.
lines.zh: : 是的，一阵嗡鸣声。

lines.en: : Then...Urrheak attempts to remove the covering on the figure’s head.
lines.zh: : 那么……Urrheak 试图揭下那身影头上的遮盖物。

lines.en: : As Urrheak begins to peel away layer after layer of cloth, a wave of calm washes over him. He’s enjoying himself.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 开始一层层剥开布料，一阵平静感涌遍他的全身。他很享受。

lines.en: : He thinks back to when he was a cleric in training — still coming to terms with his faith and learning the ways of his god.
lines.zh: : 他回想起自己还是见习牧师的时候——那时他还在与自己的信仰和解，学习自己神明的道。

lines.en: : He remembers wrapping bandages on troops returning from battle...and {i}unwrapping{/i} fresh loaves of bread and wheels of cheese that he’d purchased at the market for his family.
lines.zh: : 他记起为战场上归来的士兵包扎绷带……也记起{i}拆开{/i}他在集市上为家人买来的新鲜面包和一整轮奶酪。

lines.en: : Those days seemed so far away now...
lines.zh: : 那些日子现在看来已经那么遥远……

lines.en: : What is happening?
lines.zh: : 发生了什么？

lines.en: : As Urrheak continues to peel away at the cloth, he notices a faint purple light hiding behind it. It becomes clear that that’s where the whirring is coming from.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 继续剥着布，他注意到布料后藏着一道微弱的紫光。显然，嗡鸣声就是从那里传出来的。

lines.en: scene xmasdnd54
: Molly, what the fuck is this weird creature?
lines.zh: : Molly，这奇怪的生物到底是什么鬼东西？

lines.en: : He continues to unwrap the cloth...but as he gets closer to the truth of the creature’s face, the calmness never fades. It just keeps growing...and growing...and growing...
lines.zh: : 他继续拆着布……但随着他越来越接近那张脸的真相，那份平静从未消退。它只是不停增长……增长……再增长……

lines.en: : Urrheak! Come back down! I don’t like this!
lines.zh: : Urrheak！快下来！我不喜欢这样！

lines.en: : Yeah. Urrheak’s going to head back down now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Urrheak 现在打算下来了。

lines.en: : A voice in the back of Urrheak’s head begs him to stop, but he shrugs it off as he continues to unwrap the cloth. Then, he quickly forgets the voice ever existed in the first place.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 脑后有个声音求他停下，但他耸耸肩置之不理，继续拆着布。随后，他很快便忘却那个声音曾经存在过。

lines.en: : Isn’t there...some kind of saving throw I could use here? Maybe that dex roll I never got to use before?
lines.zh: : 难道没有……什么豁免检定我能用吗？比如之前那次没用上的敏捷检定？

lines.en: : Finally, the last bit of cloth drops to the floor. And once it does, Urrheak’s complacency vanishes.
lines.zh: : 终于，最后一块布落到了地上。而就在那一刻，Urrheak 的安然自得烟消云散。

lines.en: : As he gazes at the figure, he notices no face — but a gaping hole with a deep purple glow circling the rim, and he feels {i}fear.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他凝视着那道身影，发现那里没有脸——只有一个洞口，边缘环绕着深紫色的光晕，而他感到了{i}恐惧{/i}。

lines.en: : But he is unable to act.
lines.zh: : 但他无法行动。

lines.en: : Xessaxia draws her bowstring and-
lines.zh: : Xessaxia 拉开弓弦，然后——

lines.en: scene xmasdnd55
: The figure stomps its foot, destroying the barrier our heroes stood on in all but {i}one{/i} spot, {i}his...{/i}while the rest of them fall helplessly into the void.
lines.zh: : 那身影重重一跺脚，摧毁了我们英雄脚下的屏障，只剩{i}一处{/i}，{i}他的……{/i}而其余众人无助地坠入虚空。

lines.en: : The whirring gets louder.
lines.zh: : 嗡鸣声变大了。

lines.en: : Then, as Urrheak stares into the void inside a void — a gaping hole where a set of eyes should be, he has one more thought. But he can’t tell if it’s his or not.
lines.zh: : 随后，当 Urrheak 凝视着虚空中的虚空——那本该是双眼的位置上张开的窟窿时，他只剩下最后一个念头。可他分不清那是不是他自己的念头。

lines.en: : All it says is this.
lines.zh: : 那念头只有这一句。

lines.en: scene black
: “I’ve accomplished nothing.”
lines.zh: : 「我什么也没做成。」

lines.en: : The figure sucks him into the hole where its face should be.
lines.zh: : 那身影把他吸进了本该是脸的那个洞里。

lines.en: : Urrheak takes 10,000 points of damage.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 受到 10000 点伤害。

lines.en: {i}Urrheak has been slain!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Urrheak 已陨落！{/i}
